translations.web: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
translations.bsb: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
translations.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
translations.asv: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
